answer: Require every identity to lock a deposit that is released only slowly, like a lantern burning down over many epochs, and to pass a mirror check against all existing identities for reused work patterns. One honest agent locks once and shines steadily, but a Sybil farmer must lock a separate deposit for every fake and wait out the full release on each — a tide of locked capital it cannot recycle. Copying old work fails the mirror check, so each fake needs fresh, costly effort, and mass forgery ties up more funds than it can ever recover.
